stem: A certain number of learners are sitting for examinations in Mathematics, Tourism and Geography. The total number sitting for Mathematics (M) is {M}. For Tourism (T) is {T}. For Geography (G) is {G}. {MT} sit for M and T, but not G. {MG} sit for M and G, but not T. {TG} sit for T and G, but not M. {onlyT} sit for only Tourism.

subquestions.prompt_template: Draw a Venn diagram to represent ALL the learners.
Calculate the probability that a learner sits for at least TWO of the subjects.
steps: Count learners in exactly 2 or all 3 subjects.

subquestions.prompt_template: Determine if M and T are independent. Support your answer.
steps: Since P(M)*P(T) != P(M and T), M and T are NOT independent.
